description: Reproducible client↔server connectivity E2E test harness using podman compose. Seeds a real SQLite DB with one movie + one episode, boots the Bun server with mDNS broadcast, and runs a Dart CLI that discovers, connects, fetches library data, and streams media bytes.
deviation_notes: Switched from network_mode:host to bridge network to avoid port 8080 conflict. Used sqlite3 CLI instead of drizzle-kit migrate (ABI mismatch). Fixed PrismaClient shim findAll→findMany and $executeRawUnsafe for better-sqlite3 compat.
